description: This file defines the CustomerService class responsible for handling operations related to Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides methods to access customer data through a CustomerDao, including searching customers, counting them, and retrieving individual customer records.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for Customer entities, including fetching, searching, and counting customers.

methods.name: getCustomerDao
methods.description: Returns the CustomerDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Performs a search for customers based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the search filter.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a single Customer by its ID.
